title: PaceVLA: Adaptive Temporal Action Quantization in Vision-Language-Action Models

tldr.en: Train multiple action granularities/horizons and route execution using quantizability; optimize task execution time rather than per-call inference.
tldr.zh: 训练多种动作时间粒度与 horizon，并按可量化程度选择模式，优化任务执行时间。

evaluation_scope.en: Three simulation benchmarks and six real tasks; RTX 5090 per-call timing rises from 40.07 to 42.15 ms. Keep execution gains separate from inference speed.
evaluation_scope.zh: 3 个仿真基准与 6 项真机任务；RTX 5090 单次推理从 40.07 增至 42.15 ms。执行效率收益应与推理加速分开。
